scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.dev:electron: pnpm exec concurrently -k -n renderer,main,electron -c cyan,yellow,green "pnpm run dev:renderer" "pnpm run dev:main" "pnpm run dev:launch"
scripts.dev:launch: pnpm run ensure:electron && pnpm run ensure:native && pnpm exec wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist/main/main.js && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 pnpm exec electronmon dist/main/main.js
scripts.lint: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.start: pnpm run ensure:electron && pnpm run ensure:native && pnpm exec electron dist/main/main.js
scripts.test: node -e "console.log('Run tests from repo root: pnpm test')"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
